caption: The drawing features a mechanical object with a symmetrical, upright composition placed on a simple wooden base. The primary component is a central, hourglass-shaped container painted a deep red color with some gold accents, including a decorative band around the top and gilded floral motifs on the body. At the top, there is a domed lid with a small finial. Attached to both sides of the container are two large, circular wheels, each featuring six inward-curving spokes that form a floral pattern within the rim; the wheels are painted in red, blue, and gold. One wheel has a wooden handle extending outward, which appears to be used to rotate the wheel. The base is rectangular and appears to be made of wood with a reddish painted panel and a small round metal knob or fixture on the front. The background is an unadorned, light beige color, and the artist’s signature “Richard Taylor” appears below the object to the right.
title: Coffee Grinder
